description: Pair this MCP server to an open SurfCAD tab via the local WebSocket relay. Copy the 6-character code from SurfCAD → Local agent → Show pairing code. call register_webhook { url, bearer? } if you can receive https webhooks, otherwise poll read_messages. When you finish a task started from the SurfCAD in-viewer prompt pane, send a closing reply with reply_to_user (final: true) summarising what was done, so the user gets confirmation. On failure or partial completion, say what was done, what failed and why, and what is left. Call set_status { state: "building" } only once you have everything you need and are actually creating or editing geometry. After pairing call guide { topic: "start" } (How to build in SurfCAD: block out first, features first, hardware as patterned parts) before the first model call.

code.description: 6-character pairing code from the SurfCAD Local agent panel
